changeinfo.changes:
The following issues were addressed:
  • Master Cities unlocking bug is fixed
  • Performance of the online multiplayer has been improved for lower lag.
  • Bug that prevents the players from leaving an online lobby at certain moments is fixed.
  • Some minor changes of the game's texts.
  • Bug that could prevent some trophies from being unlocked, when the game's progress is transferred between PS3 and PS Vita, is fixed.
